title: Joe Burrow: Would be nice to break Bengals career touchdown pass record this year

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Joe Burrow: Would be nice to break Bengals career touchdown pass record this year
sources.description: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow thinks he's surrounded by more talent than at any other point in his NFL career and that has him thinking big about the kind of numbers he'll be able to put up this season.
